paper.title: Matter-induced plaquette terms in a $\mathbb{Z}_2$ lattice gauge theory
paper.authors: Matjaž Kebrič, Fabian Döschl, Umberto Borla, Jad C. Halimeh, Ulrich Schollwöck, Annabelle Bohrdt, Fabian Grusdt

results.system_description: Z2 lattice gauge theory coupled to hard-core bosons, Eq. (1) at J = 0 without the chemical-potential term, 6x6 square lattice, periodic in both directions, N = 8 particles, h/t = 0.1, physical Gauss-law sector
results.source_location: Supplemental Material, Table IV (tab_LCNN_ViT), row L-CNN, column h/t = 0.1
results.eligibility_evidence: Variational energy of the optimized L-CNN wave function, estimated by Monte Carlo sampling with the standard error of the mean; Table IV compares the two architectures on the 6x6 torus with N = 8.
results.notes: Total energy in units of t, as printed; the board divides it by the 36 sites. Hamiltonian Eq. (1) of the main text at J = 0; the NQS works at fixed particle number N = 8, so the chemical-potential term of Eq. (1) is absent (Supplemental Material, Benchmarks of the DMRG and the NQS). The calculation uses the equivalent link-only spin representation, Supplemental Material Eq. (eq_2DLGTwithSpins), obtained by integrating out the matter with Gauss's law in the physical sector G_j = +1; configurations are sampled in the tau^x basis with Gauss's law enforced, and the state is optimized by stochastic reconfiguration. Error bar: standard error of the mean (Supplemental Material, Calculating error bars). Hellmann-Feynman check: the printed h-dependence gives <sum tau^x> of about 55 at h = 0.55, below the maximum 64 = 72 - 8 allowed with 8 particles on 72 links. Printed as -E ± error; the error bar is the ± value. Parameter count 2325 from Supplemental Material Table I (6x6, N^a = 8); the paper uses the same L-CNN architecture for all its simulations, and Table IV does not restate the count.
